name: Nervousness
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of nervousness and fear but consistently directs believers to place their trust and confidence in the Lord. God commands His people to be strong and courageous, reminding them that He is always present and their comfort in times of distress. The psalmist models seeking the Lord in fear and casting burdens upon Him, who sustains and delivers from all anxieties. Even amid overwhelming thoughts, God's comforting presence brings delight and peace to the soul.
